selectionReason: 追加語のうち、同音異義語の検索混同を避ける必要がある語と、仕組み・用途・部位・場面を示すことが理解に役立つ語を選定。通常の写真で示せる動植物・食品・場所などは既存の写真検索を継続。

batches.prompt:
Create one square 4 by 4 contact sheet containing exactly sixteen equally sized square illustrations. Precise regular grid, narrow white gutters, each scene entirely within its own cell. Row-major left-to-right top-to-bottom ordering below. Warm clean children's picture-book watercolor, soft colors, gentle outlines, simple off-white backgrounds, large clear subjects legible as 256px vocabulary cards. No text, letters, labels, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks or tile numbers anywhere. Anatomically plausible hands. Each cell illustrates exactly its own concept, no mixing between cells.
Cell 1: A child giving a wrapped farewell gift to a friend departing with a suitcase; both warmly smiling.
Cell 2: A bowl of transparent thin glass noodles, some held above the bowl with chopsticks. Clearly food.
Cell 3: Gentle spring rain falling onto cherry blossoms and fresh green buds outdoors; no food.
Cell 4: A baseball pitcher on the mound winding up to throw a baseball toward home plate; glove and ball visible.
Cell 5: A clear water pitcher with a prominent handle and pouring spout, pouring water into a glass; no baseball.
Cell 6: A seated adult ventriloquist holding a small wooden puppet on one knee; puppet mouth open as if speaking, adult lips closed.
Cell 7: A blindfolded child placing loose paper eyes and a nose onto a large outline of a smiling face on the floor for a Japanese New Year game.
Cell 8: Close-up of a green bamboo stalk showing several clearly swollen ring-shaped nodes dividing the stalk.
Cell 9: A bright orange marine buoy floating upright in water near a small boat; clearly an anchored floating marker.
Cell 10: Close-up of a red tomato with its green star-shaped calyx prominently emphasized; the leafy attachment visible.
Cell 11: An elementary clepsydra water clock: upper transparent vessel dripping water slowly into a lower measuring vessel with evenly spaced tick marks but no digits, on a wooden frame. Not an hourglass.
Cell 12: At a fork in a forest path, a wooden signpost with two blank arrow-shaped boards indicating the two paths.
Cell 13: A person wearing a traditional Japanese straw rain cape made of overlapping long straw hanging from shoulders, broad straw hat, gentle rain.
Cell 14: Close-up of a child's hand with three tiny cloth animal finger puppets fitted over fingertips, clear fingers and miniature puppets.
Cell 15: A traditional Japanese ramune glass soda bottle with marble trapped in pinched neck, filled with pale blue fizz, alongside a glass. No labels.
Cell 16: A small dish of pastel round pressed-sugar ramune candies with powdery texture, several scattered beside it; no bottle.

Cell 1: A flowering Chinese milk vetch plant, Astragalus sinicus, with pink-purple clustered flowers and pinnate leaves in a rice field. No spoon.
Cell 2: A white Chinese-style ceramic soup spoon with short thick curved handle beside a bowl of soup; spoon in close-up. No flowers.
Cell 3: Three children running a footrace toward a finish line; one just ahead; joyful sports day scene. No lace fabric.
Cell 4: Close-up of delicate white lace fabric with openwork flower patterns, folded over pale blue cloth. No athletes.
Cell 5: A saucepan showing flour and butter being stirred into a thick pale golden roux paste, small flour bowl and butter pat beside it; no finished curry dish.
Cell 6: View from inside a car focusing on the rectangular interior rear-view mirror, reflection shows the road behind through rear window; dashboard faint in foreground.
Cell 7: An adult exercising on a treadmill indoors, feet on moving belt, handrails and console clear; no outdoor running.
Cell 8: A brightly colored circular prize spinner divided into colored wedges with a fixed pointer at top, no numbers, no gambling or text.
Cell 9: A cozy traditional Japanese room with a sunken square hearth in the floor, kettle hanging over it and a person sitting beside the hearth.
Cell 10: A paint roller with a cylindrical foam head on bent metal handle, rolling a clean band of blue paint on a wall.
Cell 11: A pair of traditional Japanese woven straw sandals with straw cords tied at ankles, detailed woven sole visible.
Cell 12: A diner eating a small portion of soba from a tiny lacquer bowl, server holding another small portion ready to refill, neat stack of empty tiny bowls beside diner.
Cell 13: A fine mesh round sieve sifting white flour into a bowl, fine flour falling through mesh, a few larger lumps staying above.
Cell 14: A short upright row of books supported at both ends by two clearly visible L-shaped metal bookends; books remain upright. No text on spines.
Cell 15: A child examining a small scale model house on a tabletop; a real house of matching design visible through the window; clearly a miniature model.
Cell 16: A school backpack open on a desk with a water bottle, pencil case, handkerchief and notebook laid neatly alongside, items to take to school.
